---
name: City request
about: Request a new city be added to Civic Mapper
title: 'City request: '
labels: new-city
assignees: ''
---

**Jurisdiction**
City / county / country (e.g. "Madison, WI" or "Dane County, WI").

**Parcel geometry source**
Link to the open-data portal, GIS server, or download page that provides
parcel boundaries. Note the license if you know it.

**Assessed value availability**
Where do per-parcel assessed values (land value and improvement value — or at
least land value) come from? A link to the assessor / appraisal district open
data is ideal. If values are in a separate table from the geometry, note the
join key if you know it.

**Anything else**
Data quirks, licensing concerns, or whether you'd like to build the ETL
yourself (see `docs/add-city-playbook.md` in the repo).
